resources.string: "Camera permission required to scan QR codes"
"Scan this on the other device — both must be on the same Wi-Fi network"
"Speed presets, signal realism, and location randomness for all movement modes."
"Which features appear in the floating widget and map buttons, and how to trigger walks by tapping."
"Curated hot locations and pre-built routes to populate your library."
"Default area, distance, speed, and routing style for random walks."
"Adds a curated list of popular locations to your favorites. Select which ones to include below."
"Adds a curated set of pre-built routes to your routes list. Select which ones to include below."
"Adds small random shifts to your fake location, making it look more natural. Set 0 to disable."
"Controls how the fake GPS signal behaves. These options add metadata and variation that real GPS chips produce — some apps and games inspect these signals to detect fake locations."
"Keeps the last known direction when you stop moving instead of snapping to 0° (north). Real GPS chips do the same — a sudden reset to north is a common mock-location tell."
"Simulates a plausible altitude with small random drift instead of always reporting 0 m. A flat zero altitude is an obvious signal that the location is synthetic."

"Looks up the actual ground elevation at your spoofed location every minute while spoofing, instead of a fixed ~35 m. Requires an internet connection; pauses automatically while an altitude override is active (floating widget), and falls back to the fixed value if the lookup fails."
"Clears a manually-set altitude (floating widget) and lets automatic elevation lookup resume."

"Starts each session with slightly inaccurate readings that improve over ~30 seconds, like a real GPS that takes time to lock on. Off by default because it temporarily reduces location precision at session start."
"Attaches satellite metadata to each update (7–14 satellites visible, 6–12 in fix) instead of zero. Some apps check for zero satellites as a spoofing signal."

"Briefly pauses the fake location signal every ~10 seconds, like a real GPS dropping signal momentarily. Off by default — the pauses cause visible freezes in most apps. Skipped automatically during route replay."
"Controls whether the app remembers where you left off when reopened."
"Movement speed used by the joystick, route replay, and roaming. Select a unit, then set each preset."
"Speed exceeds 8 m/s — may trigger anti-cheat in some games"
"Restores your last set position when the app restarts."
"Switch to a light theme for better readability in bright/sunny conditions."
"Choose which map tiles are shown on the map screen, floating map, favorites picker and route creator. Your saved locations and mock GPS position are unaffected."
"Amap tiles use the GCJ-02 coordinate system. Positions are converted automatically so markers, routes and taps line up; all data is still stored in WGS-84."
"Walk to a location by tapping it — no confirmation needed."
"Map scale (%1$.2f m/px) — the default works for most players; zoom the game fully out and adjust here only if it's off"
"A screen overlay that intercepts taps may increase detection chance in some games. Use at your own risk."
"Accuracy depends on the scale setting — zoom out in the game for better results."
"Removes every teleport option across the app — map, favorites, routes, group sync, and the widget. Only walking and route replay remain available."
"Skips the confirmation sheet on floating-map taps and walks there directly."
"Keeps the floating widget button from appearing while spoofing is active."
"Removes the status bar icon for the spoofing notification. Android requires the notification to keep existing — it's tucked into the notification shade instead."
"Adds Previous waypoint / Next waypoint buttons to route replay controls, for instantly teleporting between waypoints. Off by default."
"Adds a button to the floating widget for typing in a fixed altitude from anywhere. Off by default."
"Shows live speed, altitude, coordinates, and tick rate in the floating widget panel while spoofing is active."
"locationjoystick uses Android's Accessibility Service API only for the optional Compass orientation feature of Tap to Walk."
"What it accesses: a screenshot of your screen, taken when you open the Tap to Walk overlay or tap Test."
"Why: to find your game's compass icon and turn your tap into the correct walking direction."
"The screenshot is processed on your device and deleted right away. It is never saved, sent, or shared. The service does not read text, collect personal data, or act on your behalf."
"You can turn the service off at any time in Android's accessibility settings."

"When enabled, the app detects your game's compass (top-right corner, like most AR/GPS games) before each walk to correct the target position — no setup needed. Requires an Accessibility Service. Note: some games detect accessibility services."
"Not enabled — tap to open Android Settings"
"Tap Test to switch to %1$s, capture its compass, and return here."
"Select the game above, or switch to it yourself first — then tap Test. The app briefly minimizes itself to capture whatever's on screen, then returns."
"Not detected — make sure your game's compass is visible top-right"
"Choose which quick-access features appear in the floating widget and on the map screen, and drag to reorder them. Both surfaces share the same order by default."
"Opens a compact map view without switching to the main app."
"Toggles the floating joystick overlay on or off."
"Keeps the joystick moving in the last held direction after you release."
"Teleport or walk to a saved location."
"Configure and start random walking within a radius."
"Find and jump to a place by name."
"Cycles through all speed profiles with a single tap."
"Choose which speed profiles the widget's Speed Cycle button cycles through."
"Default settings used when starting a roaming session from the map."
"Follows actual roads and paths instead of cutting straight across. May not be available in all areas."
"Walks back to the starting position after the roaming session completes."
"How would you like to handle existing data?"
"All favorites, routes, and settings will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone."
"Ask the sender for their 6-character code shown in the QR share dialog."
"You have unsaved settings changes. Save them before leaving?"
"You have unsaved settings changes. Save them before starting location spoofing?"
"Connecting to sender — make sure both devices are on the same Wi-Fi"
